title: InteractionResult
description: The npc brain's decision for one interaction: which mode to switch to, an optional target/line/emote, and an optional memory note. Schema-constrained so the model physically cannot emit an off-contract action. At Phase 6 a GBNF grammar is derived from this schema; if a grammar gap forces it, additionalProperties may be relaxed there while the deterministic re-validate stays strict.

target.description: An entity id, or a world position, that must exist in the given selfContext.

utterance.description: The line the NPC speaks (may carry emotion tags).

memoryDelta.description: A note to fold into the NPC's memory.

flag.description: A named story flag this interaction sets (e.g. "gave_key"), which an unlock_dialog goal can require.
